instructions.question: What sentiment does this comment express about the COVID-19 situation, the institute, the government or the public?
instructions.rule: Judge the tone. Negative covers suspicion that figures are fake, hidden or copy-pasted, sarcasm about the institute or government, exasperated demands, alarm or despair, contemptuous blame, and virus or mask denial, even without insults. Neutral covers calm questions, arithmetic corrections, constructive suggestions, plain statistics, playful banter with tagged friends, town-ranking jokes and mild regret. Positive covers thanks, praise, blessings, encouragement, caring advice, and relief that numbers are falling.

neutral.what: Calm questions, corrections, suggestions, statistics, anecdotes, tags, friendly banter, town-league jokes, mild regret.
examples: Sa keq, numri kaq i larte [What a pity, such a high number]
Vitia e lshoj frotin [Vitia dropped off the front]
Ferdeze Qerkini Berisha mos dil pa mask [Ferdeze, don't go out without a mask]
neutral.cues: a/pse (calm questions), duhet (should), ju lutem (please), lshoi bajrakun (dropped the flag), prin (leads), ma gjall (livelier), tagged names
neutral.not_for: Questions implying the numbers are faked or hidden, and exasperated or alarmed outbursts (negative).

positive.what: Thanks, praise, sincere prayers, encouragement, caring advice to stay safe, relief or optimism about falling cases.
examples: Lakorja paska fillu me ra [The curve has started to fall]
Urime të Sheruarve! [Congratulations to the recovered!]
Kujdes vllazni se dona ta mbyllim vetëveten nëse vazhdon kshtu mbane distancën mos dilni pa nevoj [Careful brothers, or we'll lock ourselves in again, keep distance, don't go out without need]
positive.cues: urime (congratulations), ju lumt (well done), hallall (well deserved), perhajr (all the best), zoti e sheroft (God heal), po bie numri (number falling), zbut (eased)
positive.not_for: Jokey 'ishalla', or greetings and mask reminders to tagged friends (neutral).

negative.what: Distrust of the figures, sarcasm at officials, anger, exasperation, alarm, despair, contempt for the public or government, denial.
examples: Dje 226 sod 224 mos jeni tja bo copy paste. [Yesterday 226, today 224, are you copy-pasting?]
Tmerr valla,po lëvizin pa masa mbrojtëse dhe në grupe! [Horror, they move around unprotected and in groups!]
Maska = skllavëri [Mask = slavery]
"Situata është nën kontroll" [The situation is under control]
negative.cues: copy paste, rrena (lies), a ju besohet (do you believe it), diqka nuk osht n'rregull (something's not right), tmerr (horror), marre (shame), bollni ma (enough already), pha, ncncnc
negative.not_for: Neutral arithmetic corrections and playful jokes between friends (neutral).
